# exoscale_dbaas_kafka_topic_acl (Resource)

Manage a Kafka topic ACL entry of an Exoscale [Database Service (DBaaS)](https://community.exoscale.com/product/dbaas/).

The API has no update operation for ACL entries: changing any argument replaces the entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exoscale_dbaas" "my_kafka" {
  zone = "ch-gva-2"
  name = "my-kafka"
  type = "kafka"
  plan = "startup-4"
}

resource "exoscale_dbaas_kafka_user" "my_app" {
  zone     = exoscale_dbaas.my_kafka.zone
  service  = exoscale_dbaas.my_kafka.name
  username = "my-app"
}

resource "exoscale_dbaas_kafka_topic_acl" "my_app_orders" {
  zone       = exoscale_dbaas.my_kafka.zone
  service    = exoscale_dbaas.my_kafka.name
  username   = exoscale_dbaas_kafka_user.my_app.username
  topic      = "orders-*"
  permission = "readwrite"
}
```

Please refer to the [examples](https://github.com/exoscale/terraform-provider-exoscale/tree/master/examples/)
directory for complete configuration examples.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission` (String) ❗ The permission granted on the topic (`admin`, `read`, `readwrite` or `write`).
- `service` (String) ❗ The name of the Kafka database service.
- `topic` (String) ❗ The Kafka topic name or pattern (e.g. `orders-*`) the entry applies to.
- `username` (String) ❗ The Kafka username or username pattern (e.g. `app-*`) the entry applies to.
- `zone` (String) ❗ The Exoscale [Zone](https://www.exoscale.com/datacenters/) name.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `acl_id` (String) The ID of the ACL entry, assigned by the service.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource, computed as `service/acl_id`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

-> The symbol ❗ in an attribute indicates that modifying it, will force the creation of a new resource.

## Import

```shell
# The ACL entry ID is the `id` listed by `exo x get-dbaas-kafka-acl-config <service> -z <zone>`.
terraform import \
  exoscale_dbaas_kafka_topic_acl.my_app_orders \
  my-kafka/acl5ec2571aff0@ch-gva-2
```
